npcs.name: Warden Isola Garr
npcs.notes: Goal: Maintain absolute order, even at a high moral cost. Hates the messiness of Veit's corruption and the inmates' defiance.

npcs.name: Deputy Jor Veit
npcs.notes: Goal: Seize control of the prison's illicit economy. Views Garr as a naive obstacle and the inmates as customers.

npcs.name: Lyd 'Ink' Marven
npcs.notes: Caught between Garr's strict audits and Veit's threats. A key weak point in the prison's bureaucracy.

npcs.name: Husk Bram
npcs.notes: Disgusted by the corruption and cruelty. Can be convinced to look the other way for a good cause, providing access and information.

npcs.name: “Knuck” Sela
npcs.notes: Goal: Survive and profit. Manages inmate favors and contraband. If tension gets high enough, she can orchestrate a full-scale riot.

npcs.name: Lyrene Holt
npcs.notes: The player's primary channel for exposing illegal prison activities to the outside world, triggering the 'Legal' outcomes.

npcs.name: Maro 'Ink' Dast
npcs.notes: Holds evidence against a powerful Merchant Guild official. Getting him out is a major side quest with city-wide implications.

npcs.name: Tams Vekh
npcs.notes: The living proof of the Black Cells. Rescuing them provides undeniable evidence against Warden Garr.
